verdict.rationale: Dagster ships a first-party Dagster+ MCP server that lets users access information and take actions in their deployment from within an AI session, so a user can operate it through natural language via an external AI client. This is limited to Dagster+, the scope of available actions is undocumented, and there is no native natural-language interface in the product itself. The dagster-expert skill helps coding agents build projects but is not operation of the product. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions the MCP server supports, support in OSS Dagster, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.
